title: Package B: canonical records, generated views and checks
problem: Decision statuses were typed by hand in several places with nothing checking that they agreed; no player changelog or release tags.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-002 only, including its listed tests and documentation

scope: Canonical JSON records for decisions, packages and releases
npm run records: DECISIONS.md, CHANGELOG.md, the STATE pending block and PDFs
Release tagging when the owner deploys
Migration of DEC-001 to DEC-006, PLAN-001 and REP-001 to REP-003

acceptance.text: npm run records rebuilds all views; a second run changes nothing
acceptance.evidence: Second run of npm run records changed nothing (checksums of DECISIONS.md, CHANGELOG.md, STATE.md identical)

acceptance.text: records:check fails for a duplicate ID, an unknown reference, approval without evidence, an edited history line and a stale view
acceptance.evidence: Each break failed with a plain message and exit 1: duplicate DEC-008; REP-003 mentioning DEC-012; DEC-001 approved without evidence; history line 1 edited; DECISIONS.md and STATE.md stale

acceptance.text: Without pandoc the export prints PDF EXPORT BLOCKED, exits non-zero and keeps the previous PDFs
acceptance.evidence: PANDOC=/nonexistent: "PDF EXPORT BLOCKED", exit 1, all four PDFs byte-identical, no temp files left

acceptance.text: The cumulative PDF opens with pending approvals and current decisions, then REP-001 to REP-003
acceptance.evidence: Cumulative PDF (16 pages): pending approvals, current decisions, packages, details, history, then REP-001, REP-002, REP-003 in order

acceptance.text: Every decision, status and approval quote from REP-001 to REP-003 is in the records
acceptance.evidence: All DEC rows of the old hand-written register match. Differences: DEC-004 delivery "In use" is mapped to the allowed value "implemented"; DEC-007 to DEC-009 approved today (in history). Both owner quotes present

acceptance.text: verify and CI run records:check and stay green
acceptance.evidence: CI run 40276699547 on a7fa577: "RECORDS OK … history checked against 63c3682", then the full suite green; preview updated

acceptance.text: A tagging dry run on a throwaway branch shows the tag and changelog entry
acceptance.evidence: Throwaway branch: with 1.1.0 published, release check refused (exit 1); with a 1.1.1 candidate, "RELEASE OK: would tag v1.1.1" plus the changelog entry. Branch deleted; no tags created

added: Canonical records in docs/workflow/records (decisions, packages, releases)
Generated CHANGELOG.md and decision register; STATE pending block
Release check and version tag in the Deploy workflow
changed: verify runs records:check first; CI compares records history with the previous commit
PDF export is all-or-nothing and reports PDF EXPORT BLOCKED
